question: What additional types are enumerated in this part of the list?
premises: The lord of gods is addressed.
One type named is the triple-staff bearer.
Another type named is the seller of the Veda.
inference: The enumeration includes the triple-staff bearer and likewise the seller of the Veda.
plain_english: O Lord of gods, there is also the triple-staff bearer, and likewise another, the seller of the Veda.
